user.title: Set up 3D Rooms
user.description: Create a local library for your 3D rooms and floors. Upload models and connect their lights from the 3D Rooms sidebar. The dashboard card is included; no add-on or separate account is required.

confirm.title: Disconnect removed entities from {room}
confirm.description:
The 3D room **{room}** is connected to entities that no longer exist in Home Assistant: {entities}.

Select **Submit** to disconnect them. The devices stay in the room; connect them to new entities later from the 3D Rooms sidebar.

abort.gone: The room was changed or removed meanwhile.

confirm.title: Remove missing extra entities from {view}
confirm.description:
The saved 3D Rooms view **{view}** shows extra entities that no longer exist in Home Assistant: {entities}.

Select **Submit** to remove them from the view. Cards using this view update automatically.

abort.gone: The view was changed or removed meanwhile.

optimization_failed.title: 3D Rooms could not make lighter copies of {room}

confirm.title: Try optimizing {room} again
confirm.description:
Home Assistant could not make the lighter phone and desktop copies of the room **{room}**, so cards download the full upload. The room still works.

Select **Submit** to try again in the background, or use **Settings → Faster loading** for the room in the 3D Rooms sidebar. The log has details.

abort.gone: The room was changed or removed meanwhile.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reads the 3D Rooms library again and refreshes open cards and the sidebar.

retry_optimizations.name: Retry failed optimizations
retry_optimizations.description: Also try again to make lighter copies of rooms where that failed.

export_room.name: Export room
export_room.description: Saves a room, with its device connections, as a ZIP in the 3d_rooms_exports folder of your configuration directory. The ZIP can be imported again from the 3D Rooms sidebar.

room.name: Room
room.description: The room's name as shown in 3D Rooms, or its room id.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Optional file name. Defaults to the room name and the current time.
